estimates: The supporting dam and its small upstream platform are mapped. The valve-house square, height, orientation of openings and masonry detailing are estimates from written descriptions.
The choice of position on the platform and ground connection use the same crest-height reference as the separate Upper Reservoir Dam model.

review.notes: The exact valve-house photo currently in Qualla is CC BY 3.0. Its recorded 0° GPS is unusable. No image was adopted. The known mapped dam projection and written heritage description set the independent model’s position and form.
